description: Kanishka Narayan from Muzaffarpur has been appointed as the AI minister in the UK Cabinet. He moved to Cardiff with his family when he was 12 years old.
body_lead: New Delhi: Britain’s new Prime Minister Andy Burnham has opted to retain Kanishka Narayan as the minister for artificial intelligence and elevated the portfolio to a Cabinet-level position. “The Prime Minister, @andyburnham, today asked me to attend Cabinet as Minister for AI, a sign of his deep commitment to AI’s importance,” Narayan tweeted on 21 July (IST). First appointed as AI minister by former Prime Minister Keir Starmer on 7 September 2025, Narayan served in the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology. He was elected as the MP for Vale of Glamorgan in July 2024.
